card.name: Just before antidepressant brand names
card.fires_on: Positions just before or inside a brand name of a drug, mostly antidepressants such as Ludiomil, Wellbutrin and Leucovorin. It also fires on the colon, bracket, comma or 'as' or 'or' right before the brand name.

modes.label: Start of a brand name
modes.description: The first letters of a brand name, split from the rest of the name.

modes.label: Punctuation before brand
modes.description: A colon, bracket or comma that leads into a brand name in a list.

modes.label: Linking word before brand
modes.description: A small word such as 'as' or 'or' that introduces a brand name or drug.
modes.example: amitriptyline (Limbitrol®<< or>> Triavil®) have been used

card.writes: It slightly favors the word 'none' and disfavors 'negative' and 'positive', which is a weak link to the drug names.
card.plain: It lights up at the spot right before an antidepressant or other brand name is spelled out.
